description: High-level native hang workflow for all-thread triage. Use it when a live process appears stuck, deadlocked, waiting forever, or spinning and you need bounded stacks from every thread, wait-state/deadlock heuristics, and cross-thread Pointer-Provenance v2. In current mode it inspects an existing configured session and pauses a running live target when necessary; codelldb, lldb-dap, gdb, and live modes can launch or attach to an authorized local target, observe it for a bounded interval, then pause it for evidence. Do not use executable/attach modes when target execution or debugger control is not authorized, and do not treat a deadlock-candidate as a proven lock cycle because generic DAP does not expose portable lock ownership.

adapterPath.description: Optional explicit CodeLLDB, lldb-dap, or GDB executable path; omit to use adapter discovery.

analysis.description: Optional project roots/modules used to recognize project-controlled frames across all threads.

projectModules.description: Optional executable/library names treated as project-controlled modules during all-thread triage.

projectRoots.description: Optional local source roots used to recognize project-controlled frames across all captured threads.

args.description: Command-line arguments for codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb launch modes.

captureTimeoutMs.description: Global deadline for all-thread stack/scope/variable evidence collection after the pause phase. When it expires, remaining threads are retained as partial/unclassified evidence instead of extending the workflow per thread.

configuration.description: Required only for mode=live: adapter-specific DAP launch/attach configuration.

cwd.description: Working directory for adapter-owned launches and a project-root hint for hang triage.

env.description: Environment variables supplied to adapter-owned launched programs.

framesWithVariables.description: Maximum frames per thread whose locals/arguments are collected, prioritizing the top frame and first project-controlled frame.

maxThreads.description: Maximum threads to collect for bounded all-thread triage.

maxVariablesPerFrame.description: Maximum local/argument variables collected per selected frame scope for Pointer-Provenance v2.

mode.description: current triages the configured session; live uses an already initialized generic DAP adapter; codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb discover and start that adapter before launch/attach.

observeMs.description: Bounded interval after launch/attach during which a normal stop or process exit prevents automatic hang-timeout classification.

pauseBudgetMs.description: Aggregate wall-clock budget across thread enumeration and all pause requests. This prevents per-thread pause timeouts from multiplying across large thread sets.

pauseTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for any single pause request used to freeze a suspected live hang.

pid.description: Required for codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb attach modes; ignored for launch and generic live configuration.

program.description: Required for codelldb/lldb-dap/gdb launch; optional executable image hint for adapter-specific attach.

request.description: For live or adapter-owned modes, launch starts a program and attach connects to an existing authorized process.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for starting and configuring an adapter-owned DAP session.

sessionId.description: Optional DAP session ID. Omit to use the backward-compatible default session.

stackLevels.description: Maximum stack frames collected per thread.

name: debug_this_hang
title: Debug This Hang
